User.title: User
User.description: Represents an authenticated user profile in Canopy.

id.description: Unique identifier of the user (matches auth.uid).

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

Plant.title: Plant
Plant.description: A plant or grow journal entry belonging to a user.

userId.description: Owner user ID of the plant.

medium.description: Growing medium (Soil, Coco, Hydro, Living soil, etc.).

started.description: ISO date string when the grow started.

stageStarted.description: ISO date string when current stage began.

cover.description: Data URL or photo URL for the plant cover image.

logs.description: List of journal logs recorded for this plant.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the plant was last modified.

PlantScan.title: PlantScan
PlantScan.description: AI diagnostic health analysis scan of a plant or leaf photo.

userId.description: User ID who requested the scan.

plantName.description: Optional name of the scanned plant.

condition.description: Diagnosed condition or primary health assessment.

healthScore.description: Overall plant health rating from 0 to 100.

confidence.description: Confidence level of diagnosis (High, Medium, Low).

analysis.description: Detailed explanation of symptoms, causes, and stage.

recommendations.description: Actionable care, nutrient, or watering recommendations.

photo.description: Scanned image data URL or thumbnail.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the scan was generated.

/users/{userId}/plants/{plantId}.description: Subcollection of plants belonging to a user.

/users/{userId}/scans/{scanId}.description: Subcollection of AI diagnostic scans belonging to a user.
